name: Prompt Constructor
summary: Template-based prompt builder that interpolates @variableName placeholders with text from upstream Prompt nodes.

inputs.description: Multiple text inputs from Prompt nodes (matched by variableName)

outputs.description: The fully interpolated prompt template with all @variable placeholders resolved

executionNotes: Stores a template string with @variableName placeholders. Connected Prompt nodes that have a matching variableName will have their text substituted into the template. Tracks unresolvedVars for variables that have no upstream connection. Outputs the final interpolated text.

exampleConnections.scenario: Connect multiple Prompt nodes with different variableNames to populate a template
Pass the interpolated template to an image generation node
